svg.title: SPAD Search-Policy RL with Answer Distillation
svg.desc: A three-stage architecture diagram for SPAD: teacher-grounded search-policy reinforcement learning, on-policy answer refresh, and answer distillation with preference learning.
svg.text: SPAD: Search-Policy RL with Answer Distillation
Decouple search-policy credit assignment from answer generation, then distill evidence-grounded answers back into the actor.
what, how many rounds, when to stop
evidence context to precise short answer

g.text: Answer body is not trained here
credit assigned to search and stop decisions
search history is frozen into the answer context

svg.text: A strong teacher evaluates whether the search evidence is answerable; the small actor is not penalized for weak answer wording during search-policy learning.
